e19_selfreport: I ran no listing, no glob and no recursive search, on SP, on OUT or anywhere else, and no existence check. Every worktree file was opened by an exact path written in the brief or named by the pinned landed-outputs manifest. Content search was used only on single files by exact path (my brief, my own scripts). I opened no receipt file, no transcript, no final_message file, nothing of another book and nothing of lane B, including its task output, and did not message it. _test_close_book_gates.py was read only, never run. check_atlas_rows.py ran only with --out-root in my OUT; check_method_record.py ran only as a copy. I ran no git, wrote no receipt, did not touch the registry, and wrote only in my OUT.
